title: My Family
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 1 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Families differ: a child who lives with a grandparent or guardian names the people who care for him or her. Never ask who is missing.

skills.key_step: The child names family members and items a family shares at home.

floor.question: Will you share your crayons with a friend?

board.do: Draw a family at a table with one pot of food.
Wait for the child to say the family.

misconceptions.ask: Name a member of your family.
misconceptions.repair: Sort pictures: people in the family and animals at home.

misconceptions.ask: Does a family share one toothbrush?
misconceptions.repair: Show personal items and shared items in two baskets.

misconceptions.ask: Are brothers and sisters part of the family?
misconceptions.repair: Draw a family with children and grandparents.

misconceptions.ask: Should a family share food at home?
misconceptions.repair: Role-play a family meal where food is shared.

checks.question: Name a member of your family.
Name an item a family shares.
